#Citizenship

🔺️ BY DESCENT

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after January 26, 1950 but before December 10, 1992 is a citizen of India by descent, if his father was a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after December 10, 1992 is considered as a citizen of India if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ December 3, 2004 onwards, a person born outside India shall not be a citizen of India by descent, unless his birth is registered at an Indian consulate within one year of the date of birth or with the permission of the 
Central Government, after the expiry of the said period.

4 .Who won the gold medal in the women's hammer throw event with a record throw of 66.53 meters at the National Open Athletics Championships 2026?

Answer: - Anushka Yadav / अनुष्का यादव

5 .How many public sector oil marketing companies has the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) established a special dollar window for to meet their daily foreign exchange needs?
भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) ने सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की कितनी तेल विपणन कंपनियों की दैनिक विदेशी मुद्रा जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए एक विशेष डॉलर विंडो शुरू की है?
Answer: - Three / तीन

6 .Who won the men's 100-meter sprint with a timing of 10.25 seconds at the 65th National Open Athletics Championships held in New Delhi?
नई दिल्ली में आयोजित 65वीं राष्ट्रीय ओपन एथलेटिक्स चैंपियनशिप में 10.25 सेकंड का समय निकालकर पुरुषों की 100 मीटर स्प्रिंट किसने जीती?
Answer: - Manikanta Hoblidhar / मणिकांत होबलीधर

7 .Who won the gold medal in the men's 400-meter race at the National Open Athletics Championships?
राष्ट्रीय ओपन एथलेटिक्स चैंपियनशिप में पुरुषों की 400 मीटर दौड़ का स्वर्ण पदक किसने जीता?
Answer: - Akash Raj / आकाश राज

8 .In which city was The Trojan Project (Cyber Trojan Horse) recently unveiled at the cybersecurity and hacking conference (c0c0n 2026)?
हाल ही में 'द ट्रोजन प्रोजेक्ट' (साइबर ट्रोजन हॉर्स) का अनावरण किस शहर में आयोजित साइबर सुरक्षा और हैकिंग सम्मेलन (c0c0n 2026) में किया गया?
Answer: - Kochi / कोच्चि

9 .On the border of which two states is the recently discussed Kulsai Hydroelectric Project located?
हाल ही में चर्चा में रही कुलसी जलविद्युत परियोजना किन दो राज्यों की सीमा पर स्थित है?
Answer: - Assam and Meghalaya / असम और मेघालय

10 .What is the primary objective of providing financial assistance under the Bhagini Nivedita Scheme launched by the West Bengal government?
पश्चिम बंगाल सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई भगिनी निवेदिता योजना (Bhagini Nivedita Scheme) का मुख्य उद्देश्य किसे वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है?
Answer: - Unmarried women pursuing higher education / उच्च शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रही अविवाहित महिलाएं

11 .To which state does the famous temple prasad 'Ambaji Mohanthal', which recently received the Geographical Indication (GI Tag), belong?
हाल ही में भौगोलिक संकेत (GI Tag) प्राप्त करने वाला प्रसिद्ध मंदिर प्रसाद 'अंबा जी मोहनथाल' किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
Answer: - Gujarat / गुजरात

📌 ACQUISITION OF CITIZENSHIP.

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.
